analogy_notice: PID 0/PID 1 and LFS are architectural analogies, not literal equivalences between Linux processes and the concept of HUMAN.

lifecycle.host_environment: External knowledge and practical environment used during exploration and construction.
lifecycle.chroot_transition: A proposed independence test: the constructed system must operate without relying on temporary scaffolding except explicitly declared interfaces.
exit_criteria: A rebuild can be performed from recorded sources and instructions.
Unknowns and unverified claims remain visible.

nodes.name: Environment and world practices

source.claim: LFS documents a staged build process using an existing host environment.
LFS builds the new system using an already installed Linux distribution (the host).
After the toolchain passes, the build no longer depends on the host distribution except the running kernel.

nodes.falsification_or_revision_condition: A cited practice is shown to be obsolete, misrepresented, inapplicable, or contradicted by stronger reproducible evidence.

evidence.check: Retrieved LFS 12.1, chapter 1.1 'How to Build an LFS System' (web search)
evidence.result: Page states the new system is built using an already installed Linux distribution (the host). Claim confirmed.

evidence.check: Retrieved LFS 9.0, chapter 1.1 (older book version, web search)
evidence.result: Page states that after the toolchain stage the build no longer depends on the host except the running kernel. Confirmed for 9.0 only; not re-checked in current stable.

nodes.name: HUMAN whole-system core

source.claim: HUMAN is treated as a whole not reducible to a sum of individuals or tools.

replaceable_by: revised principle with recorded rationale and impact analysis
nodes.falsification_or_revision_condition: A clearly defined counterexample demonstrates that the principle is internally inconsistent or fails its stated purpose. Revision requires recording the counterexample, scope, and consequences.

nodes.name: Scalars and observables

source.claim: Measurements are partial observations and must not be mistaken for the whole.

nodes.falsification_or_revision_condition: A measure cannot be operationally defined, is not reproducible, or creates a misleading proxy for the property it claims to represent.

nodes.name: Teacher sources (concrete, replaceable)

source.claim: Learning sources may include people, nature, practice, history, experiments, tools, and AI.

nodes.falsification_or_revision_condition: A source is unreliable for the specific claim, cannot be traced, or its teaching fails reproducible practical tests.

nodes.name: Learning interface and capability

source.claim: The core depends on the capability to receive and verify new experience, not on any particular teacher or source.

nodes.falsification_or_revision_condition: Removing or replacing any single teacher source breaks the experience-to-core update loop, or the interface admits an input without recording its provenance.

nodes.name: Lifecycle, service supervision, and unresolved-work reaping

source.claim: Linux PID 1 has special process-lifecycle responsibilities; this node borrows the supervision/reaping idea metaphorically.

nodes.falsification_or_revision_condition: A lifecycle transition loses work, hides an unresolved decision, or cannot recover from a failed component.

nodes.name: Package audit of the PID1 podgon (polymath_agent_final_package.zip + ЧЕЛОВЕК.zip)

source.claim: Delivered package: 10 files, 64313 bytes unpacked (README, TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION, ROADMAP, ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW, 3 python kernels v1-v3, 3 HTML dashboards v1-v3).
Provenance dialog ДИАЛОГ_СЕССИИ_ЧЕЛОВЕК.md: 3628 bytes, 6 session stages of 'СУБЪЕКТ = PID1 (LFS ENGINE)'.
Verbatim audit log of the fresh verification run (unzip composition, secret scan, dangerous-pattern scan, isolated v3 run, CDN counts, duplicate probes).
lex-naturae collection of 8 audit claims, each backed by CSV-cell measurements and verbatim log excerpts.

replaceable_by: re-audit after any change to the package files
nodes.falsification_or_revision_condition: Any secret pattern, network/exec pattern, non-zero isolated v3 exit code, or an account duplicate of the package content found later → node status reverts to UNKNOWN and the podgon is quarantined pending re-audit.

evidence.check: Fresh audit run verify_podgon.sh captured verbatim in evidence/output.log (sha256 25c3030f3bbbda4f…)
evidence.result: 0 secret-pattern matches; 0 network/exec pattern matches (imports stdlib-only); v3 isolated run exit 0 with final entropy 0.01; CDN refs only in dashboard v3 (2), none in v1/v2; no duplicates in checked account targets (polymath-core 404×2).

evidence.check: Content layer per HOUSE canon: lex_naturae.py on claims.json (8 claims: composition, no-secrets, no-netexec, v3-exit0, v3-entropy, cdn-v3-only, dialog-facts, no-duplicates)
evidence.result: valid=true, 8/8 claims SUPPORTED, CHECKED_AGAINST_LOCAL_ARTIFACTS (csv_cell_value + text_excerpt); graph_warnings: shared evidence files (single audit log) — disclosed.

rules.whole_is_not_component: No node, model, institution, metric, or source may declare itself the whole.
rules.no_silent_promotion: Unverified input must not become a verified fact merely by being repeated or incorporated.
rules.chroot_rule: Узел scaffold=false не может иметь runtime-зависимость от scaffold=true, кроме как из узла role=INTERFACE через запись в declared_interfaces (substitutable=true, с причиной).
rules.pass_requires_evidence: PASS только при непустом evidence {check,result,date,source_ref}; source_ref — один из uri самого узла и не 'conversation'; check/result не пустые по смыслу.
rules.runtime_cycles: Циклы в runtime-графе запрещены, если не объявлены в declared_runtime_cycles с причиной.
rules.lock: BUILD_GRAPH.lock.json хранит хэш каждого узла; потеря, новый или изменённый узел без --update-lock — ошибка.

declared_interfaces.reason: Интерфейс обучения питается учителями в рантайме, но принимает любой источник с проверкой происхождения; конкретный учитель остаётся заменяемым.
